name: AI Halloween Costume Try-On: See Yourself in a Costume Before You Buy
blurb: An AI Halloween costume try-on shows you in a costume, on your own body, before you buy or make it.

prompts.text: Use the uploaded image as the base. Keep the person's face, facial features, skin tone, hair color, hairstyle, age, height and body shape exactly the same as in the photo, so they see how the costume really looks on them. Do not slim, reshape or beautify the face or the body. Dress the person in a complete, high-quality Halloween costume made for an adult: a classic witch costume with a tall black pointed hat with a wide brim, a long black witch robe with lace sleeves, a short black cape and black boots, plus light, matching makeup that keeps the face fully recognizable. The costume fits the person well, like a good store-bought costume. The person stands full body, head to shoes, at a cozy Halloween house party at night and smiles at the camera in a relaxed pose: orange string lights, carved jack-o'-lanterns on a table, paper bats on the wall and a few friends blurred in the background. A real phone photo taken by a friend with the flash on, natural skin texture, slight grain. The face and the whole costume are sharp and in focus. Vertical 9:16. Exactly one person in focus. No camera app interface, no icons, no frames or overlays. No text, no logos, no brand marks.

Use the two uploaded images as the base. The person in the first image stands on the LEFT. The person in the second image stands on the RIGHT. Keep each person's face, facial features, skin tone, hair, age, height and body shape exactly the same as in their own photo. Do not blend the two people, do not swap their faces, and do not slim or beautify anyone. Dress the two in a matching Halloween couple costume made for adults: an elegant vampire couple. Both wear dark Victorian-style outfits in black and deep red that suit each person, high-collared black capes with a blood-red lining, small fangs and pale vampire makeup with dark lips that keeps each face fully recognizable. The costumes fit well, like good store-bought costumes. The two stand side by side, full body, head to shoes, close together with an arm around each other, smiling at the camera at a cozy Halloween house party at night: orange string lights, carved jack-o'-lanterns on a table, paper bats on the wall and a few friends blurred in the background. A real phone photo taken by a friend with the flash on, natural skin texture, slight grain. Both faces and both costumes are sharp and in focus. Vertical 9:16. Exactly two people in focus. No camera app interface, no icons, no frames or overlays. No text, no logos, no brand marks.

prompts.label: 1. Open [AI Photo with this template](https://www.makeviral.ai/photo?template=ai-halloween-costume&variant=reveal) and add your photo (your photo, whole body). The photo prompt is filled in
prompts.text: Use the uploaded image as the base. Keep the person's face, facial features, skin tone, hair, age, body shape and their own everyday clothes and shoes exactly the same as in the photo. Place the person full body, head to shoes, in the middle of a cozy Halloween house party at night, standing and facing the camera with a playful, excited smile: orange string lights, carved jack-o'-lanterns on a table, paper bats on the wall and a few friends blurred in the background. Leave some space around the person. A real phone photo with a soft flash, natural skin texture, slight grain. Vertical 9:16. Exactly one person in focus, still in their everyday clothes, no costume yet. No camera app interface, no icons, no frames or overlays. No text, no logos.

prompts.label: 3. Press the film button on the still to open AI Video with the still as the first frame. Settings: Seedance 2.0 Mini, 6 s, 720p, 9:16, sound on. The video prompt
prompts.text: One continuous handheld phone shot at a Halloween house party at night, with no cuts. Keep the person's face, hair and body exactly as in the image for the whole clip. The person grins at the camera, snaps their fingers and does one quick full spin on the spot. During the spin, a swirl of orange sparks and soft smoke wraps around them and their everyday clothes change into a complete witch costume: a tall black pointed hat, a long black witch robe with lace sleeves, a short cape and black boots. They stop facing the camera in the full costume, strike a proud pose and laugh. Only the clothes change, the face stays the same. The friends in the blurred background cheer. Audio: party chatter, a magical whoosh and sparkle on the spin, friends cheering, and an original playful spooky tune. No text, no logos.
